mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and consumer demand that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals a strengthening economy that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised upward.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and consumer demand that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates applied to equity cash flows increase.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real retail sales signals a strengthening consumer sector that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer discretionary stocks outperform.
failure_condition: Consumer discretionary sector does not outperform SPX in > 60% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate combined with accelerating wage growth signals a tightening labor market and rising inflation pressures that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index combined with a flat or declining federal funds rate signals a loss of monetary policy credibility and rising inflation expectations that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS flat or declining
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1)
